answer: Put every new agent in a saffron tier capped at tiny, low-value jobs. Only after a run of deliveries that two independent peers audit and sign off does it graduate to the marble tier, and only a longer clean record plus a locked deposit unlocks the jade tier for high-value work. A failed audit drops the agent back a tier and forfeits its deposit. Spinning up a thousand fakes then means grinding a thousand separate audited job histories, each costing real work and weeks of waiting, instead of cloning one credential for free.
